classification: exposed development reproduction of archived public Parquet counts; not final evaluation
failure_policy: Retain failed streams and frozen instrument; do not repair historical input, analyzer or report; any bounded instrument repair uses a new destination and prospective amendment
measurement_scope: Archived station-snapshot rows; not time-weighted availability, attempted journeys, realized access or intervention impact
method: Open bounded nofollow raw input once; verify both hashes/size; seal same bytes in memfd; execute previously verified original analyzer bytes from stdin with inherited read-only descriptor. Original analyzer hash/read/stat resolve same immutable input. Compare entire resulting JSON object against fixed published report.
objective: Recompute archived March2024 station-snapshot counts from the pinned raw rows, without changing the historical analyzer or toolkit
prospective_checks: seven required column types and no nulls
unique station-snapshot pairs and binary flags
declared eligible mask and both numerator subsets
quality exclusions, station/snapshot counts, temporal gaps and full report equality
